title: Umumenyeshamakuru w’Umwuzure Mukuru
intro: Uwo muntu yahagaze nk’inkingi y’ukwihangana mu binjana n’ibindi, ahamagara ikibano c’abanyaruyeri ku muco w’ukuri mu gihe cari gihanganye n’ugutwengwa no kwangwa. Naho hari ibintu bigoye cane kandi ubutumwa bwari bufise uburemere bujanye n’ibisekuru, uwo musuku yagumye ashikamye mu gikorwa cabo gushika itegeko rya nyuma risohotse.
clues: Naramaze imyaka amajana icenda na mirongo itanu mpamagara abantu banje mu nzira y’ubugororotsi, ku murango no mw’ijoro, mu mpisho no ku mugaragaro.
Naburiye abantu banje igihano kibabaje, yamara bashize intoke mu matwi, bipfuka impuzu zabo mu bwibone.
Nategetswe kwubaka ikintu kinini cane munsi y’amaso y’Umukama wanje ari maso, naho ata mazi yariho.
Uko nakora, abarongozi b’abantu banje bararenga bakantwenga, ariko ndababwira ko vuba tuzoba ari twebwe tubatwenga.
Naratakambiye umubiri wanje n’amaraso yanje ngo binyifatanyeko, ariko bahisemwo kurondera ubuhungiro ku musozi, bizera ko wobakiza umuyaga wariko uraduga.
Amaherezo ubwato bwanje bwaje kuruhukira ku musozi Yudi isi imaze kumira amazi yayo, ikirere na co kigahagarika imvura nyinshi.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
